source_findings.finding: Default block=2 seconds; norewinds mode sets a 50 ms maximum.
Requested-latency callback updates block size and maximum request/rewind without resetting the already-rendered timestamp.
Render fills up to now + block_usec and advances timestamp by rendered frames.
Opened sinks including IDLE render only once timestamp <= now, unless a requested rewind pulls timestamp back.

interpretation: Up to 2 seconds of idle rendering can couple to first-stream/monitor startup. The recorder readiness delay of 1.917 seconds is consistent; this is not proof that every observed media startup failure has this cause.
current_observation_chain: parec --latency-msec=50; require >=19200 bytes of complete s16le stereo frames before launching guest, bounded by 3 seconds.
comparison_result: API 8/8 and strict independent 660 Hz PCM play/pause/resume/stop PASS; no unexpected silence >1ms.
